parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The order in which the entries are sorted based on creation time. Valid values:

*   **Asc** (default): ascending order
*   **Desc**: descending order

Enumerated values:

*   asc
*   desc

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **5 to 30**. Default value: **10**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-snapshot-detect-porn-config --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --order Asc --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLiveSnapshotDetectPornConfig --region cn-hangzhou --Order Asc --PageNum 1 --PageSize 10 --DomainName 'example.com' --AppName liveApp0000
